system.description:
You weave chakra creating animated illusions of a creature’s shadow within range, causing it to attack.

When you cast this jutsu or as a bonus action on subsequent turns for this jutsu’s duration, command the shadow to attack. Make a ranged Genjutsu attack against a creature in range. On a hit, you deal 2d10 psychic damage and they must make an Intelligence saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature becomes Demoralized and begin to see glimpses of snakes and other creatures converging on them as they are Restrained by the shadows until the end of their next turn.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but they are Restrained for the duration. Restrained creatures remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the Restrained condition on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the number of creatures you target with this jutsu by +1. If cast at C-Rank or higher, increase this jutsu’s damage by 1d10 and ranks of Demoralized by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher attacks targeting creatures with ranks of Demoralized gain a +1 bonus to its critical threat range.
